storage.evidence: BrainDB class in src/nexara_prime/brain/db.py (249 lines) manages isolated SQLite connection to .nexara/brain_state.db, completely separate from .nexara/store.db. Implements full CRUD (insert_memory, get_memory, get_memory_by_key, recall, update_memory, update_status) plus auxiliary methods (log_consolidation, log_access, save_health_snapshot, record_provenance, get_provenance, count_by_layer, count_by_kind, count_active, count_stale, close). Uses threading.RLock for concurrent safety.

schemas.evidence: BrainDB._init_schema() loads schemas/brain_state_schema.sql which defines 6 tables: brain_memories (19 columns with 5 indices), memory_decay_state (5 columns + 13 seed rows), memory_consolidation_log (7 columns), memory_access_log (5 columns + 1 index), memory_health_snapshots (11 columns), memory_provenance_chain (7 columns + 2 indices). All 6 tables correspond to BrainDB methods: brain_memories→insert/recall, memory_decay_state→get_decay_config, memory_consolidation_log→log_consolidation, memory_access_log→log_access, memory_health_snapshots→save_health_snapshot, memory_provenance_chain→record_provenance.

classification.evidence: consolidation_rules.py provides classify_layer() mapping all 13 MemoryKind values to 4 layers: working (short_term, temporary_context, unverified_inference), episodic (decision, failure), semantic (fact, user_fact, project_fact, preference, failure_experience), procedural (patch, skill_improvement, system_rule). Promotion thresholds: WORKING_TO_SEMANTIC_ACCESS_THRESHOLD=3, SEMANTIC_TO_PROCEDURAL_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.9, SEMANTIC_TO_PROCEDURAL_ACCESS_THRESHOLD=10. MemoryController.classify_with_confidence() returns (layer, confidence, decay_rate) tuple.

retrieval.evidence: MemoryController.rank_retrieve() implements relevance+recency+confidence scoring with keyword matching, exponential recency decay over 30-day window, and combined score weighting (0.5/0.25/0.25). MemoryController.cross_layer_query() delegates to rank_retrieve across all 4 layers. Both log access events via BrainDB.

evidence_binding.evidence: 10 required kinds (fact, user_fact, project_fact, preference, decision, failure, failure_experience, patch, skill_improvement, system_rule) raise ValueError if evidence_id missing. 3 optional kinds (short_term, temporary_context, unverified_inference) allowed without evidence. ProvenanceTracker records memory_id→evidence_id→source_file→commit_sha→trace_id chain. ProvenanceTracker.compute_chain_hash() produces SHA-256 for integrity verification.

minor_observations: BrainDB._init_schema() only loads schema when schema file exists at relative path 'schemas/brain_state_schema.sql' — test fixtures must provide their own schema or have schemas/ on CWD
decay_tick() operates on created_at timestamp rather than a dedicated last_decayed_at column; repeated decay_ticks re-calculate from creation time rather than incremental decay
LongTermMemory.detect_supersession() uses bare string 'superseded' as superseded_by value rather than a structured reference to the new memory ID that supersedes it
garbage_collect() performs linear scan of all active records — may need indexing for large-scale datasets
ProvenanceTracker uses TYPE_CHECKING guard for BrainDB import — good practice for avoiding circular imports
